mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO TB_REPORT_HISTORY ( reportId, status, userId, modifiedAt, deviceIdx, currentDateTime, location, pileNo, pileStandard, drillingDepth, directDrillingDepth, stDrillingDepth, sdDrillingDepth, intrusionDepth, balance, connectLength, managedStandard, avgPenetrationValue, totalPenetrationValue, hammaT, fallMeter, createDate, pileType, method, totalConnectWidth, isDel, ultimateBearingCapacity, crossSection, hammaEfficiency, modulusElasticity, bigo, isDuple, sprCol1 ) SELECT R.id, #{status}, #{userId}, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00'), R.deviceIdx, R.currentDateTime, R.location, R.pileNo, R.pileStandard, R.drillingDepth, R.directDrillingDepth, R.stDrillingDepth, R.sdDrillingDepth, R.intrusionDepth, R.balance, R.connectLength, R.managedStandard, R.avgPenetrationValue, R.totalPenetrationValue, R.hammaT, R.fallMeter, R.createDate, R.pileType, R.method, R.totalConnectWidth, R.isDel, R.ultimateBearingCapacity, R.crossSection, R.hammaEfficiency, R.modulusElasticity, R.bigo, R.isDuple, R.sprCol1 FROM TB_REPORT R WHERE R.id = #{reportId}
SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()

INSERT INTO TB_PENETRATION_HISTORY ( reportHistoryId, penetrationId, reportIdx, p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, p9, p10 ) SELECT #{id}, MIN(P.id), P.reportIdx, MAX(CASE WHEN P.idx = 1 THEN P.value END), MAX(CASE WHEN P.idx = 2 THEN P.value END), MAX(CASE WHEN P.idx = 3 THEN P.value END), MAX(CASE WHEN P.idx = 4 THEN P.value END), MAX(CASE WHEN P.idx = 5 THEN P.value END), MAX(CASE WHEN P.idx = 6 THEN P.value END), MAX(CASE WHEN P.idx = 7 THEN P.value END), MAX(CASE WHEN P.idx = 8 THEN P.value END), MAX(CASE WHEN P.idx = 9 THEN P.value END), MAX(CASE WHEN P.idx = 10 THEN P.value END) FROM ( SELECT P.*, @row_num1 := @row_num1 + 1 AS idx FROM TB_PENETRATION P, (SELECT @row_num1 := 0) R WHERE P.reportIdx = #{reportId} ORDER BY P.id ASC ) P GROUP BY P.reportIdx

INSERT INTO TB_PIECE_HISTORY ( reportHistoryId, reportIdx, singleLevel, topLevel, middleLevel, bottomLevel ) SELECT #{id}, P.reportIdx, MAX(CASE WHEN P.name = '단본' THEN P.value END), MAX(CASE WHEN P.name = '상단' THEN P.value END), GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN P.name = '중단' THEN P.value END ORDER BY P.id SEPARATOR ','), MAX(CASE WHEN P.name = '하단' THEN P.value END) FROM TB_PIECE P WHERE P.reportIdx = #{reportId} GROUP BY P.reportIdx
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_REPORT_HISTORY H INNER JOIN TB_REPORT R ON R.id = H.reportId

SELECT
FROM TB_REPORT_HISTORY H LEFT JOIN TB_DEVICE D ON D.id = H.deviceIdx LEFT JOIN TB_PENETRATION_HISTORY PH ON PH.reportHistoryId = H.id LEFT JOIN TB_PIECE_HISTORY PI ON PI.reportHistoryId = H.id WHERE H.id = #{id}

SELECT
FROM TB_REPORT_HISTORY H LEFT JOIN TB_DEVICE D ON D.id = H.deviceIdx LEFT JOIN TB_PENETRATION_HISTORY PH ON PH.reportHistoryId = H.id LEFT JOIN TB_PIECE_HISTORY PI ON PI.reportHistoryId = H.id WHERE H.reportId = #{reportId} AND H.id > #{historyId} ORDER BY H.id ASC LIMIT 1
